title: SSC CGL Mains 2026 - Trigonometry & Height-Distance (25 Qs)
subtitle: Identities, Minima/Maxima, Inverse properties & Angle Elevations
instructions: 25 Questions on Trigonometric Identities, Heights & Distances, and Radians.

questions.question_en: Let PQR be a right angled triangle, right-angled at R. Let PQ = 29cm, QR = 21cm and ∠Q = θ. Find the value of cos²θ – sin²θ.
questions.question_hi: ज्ञात है कि PQR एक समकोण त्रिभुज है, जो R पर समकोण है। मान लीजिए PQ = 29 सेमी, QR = 21 सेमी और ∠Q = θ है। cos²θ – sin²θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
In △PQR: Base QR = 21, Hypotenuse PQ = 29.
Perpendicular PR = √(29² - 21²) = √(841 - 441) = √400 = 20 cm. (20, 21, 29 is a triplet)
cos θ = 21/29, sin θ = 20/29.
cos²θ - sin²θ = (21/29)² - (20/29)² = (441 - 400)/841 = 41/841.

questions.question_en: If cos 27° = p/q, then find the value of cosec 27° – cos 63°.
questions.question_hi: यदि cos 27° = p/q है, तो cosec 27° – cos 63° का मान ज्ञात कीजिए:
questions.solution:
cos 27° = p/q ⇒ sin 27° = √(q² - p²)/q.
cos 63° = sin 27°.
cosec 27° - cos 63° = (1/sin 27°) - sin 27° = (1 - sin² 27°) / sin 27° = cos² 27° / sin 27°
= (p/q)² / [√(q² - p²)/q] = p² / [q √(q² - p²)].

questions.question_en: If sin A = 8/17, then what is the value of cot A + sec A?
questions.question_hi: यदि sin A = 8/17 है, तो cot A + sec A का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
(8, 15, 17) is a triplet: Perpendicular = 8, Base = 15, Hypotenuse = 17.
cot A = 15/8, sec A = 17/15.
cot A + sec A = 15/8 + 17/15 = (225 + 136) / 120 = 361 / 120 = 3 1/120.

questions.question_en: In △ABC, right angled at B, if tan A = 1/2, then the value of [sin A(cos C + cos A)] / [cos C(sin C – sin A)] is:
questions.question_hi: △ABC में, जो B पर समकोण है, यदि tan A = 1/2 है, तो [sin A(cos C + cos A)] / [cos C(sin C – sin A)] का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Since ∠B = 90°, A + C = 90° ⇒ cos C = sin A and sin C = cos A.
Numerator = sin A(sin A + cos A).
Denominator = sin A(cos A - sin A).
Expression = (sin A + cos A) / (cos A - sin A) = (tan A + 1) / (1 - tan A)
= (1/2 + 1) / (1 - 1/2) = (3/2) / (1/2) = 3.

questions.question_en: If a cot θ + b cosec θ = p and b cot θ + a cosec θ = q, then p² – q² is equal to:
questions.question_hi: यदि a cot θ + b cosec θ = p और b cot θ + a cosec θ = q है, तो p² – q² किसके बराबर है?
questions.solution:
p² - q² = (a cot θ + b cosec θ)² - (b cot θ + a cosec θ)²
= a² cot²θ + b² cosec²θ + 2ab cot θ cosec θ - [b² cot²θ + a² cosec²θ + 2ab cot θ cosec θ]
= b²(cosec²θ - cot²θ) - a²(cosec²θ - cot²θ)
= b²(1) - a²(1) = b² - a².
questions.trick: p² - q² = b² - a² (since cosec²θ - cot²θ = 1).

questions.question_en: What is the value of (1 – 2 sin²θ cos²θ) / (sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ) + 4 equal to?
questions.question_hi: (1 – 2 sin²θ cos²θ) / (sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ) + 4 का मान किसके बराबर है?
questions.solution:
sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)² - 2 sin²θ cos²θ = 1 - 2 sin²θ cos²θ.
Therefore, (1 - 2 sin²θ cos²θ) / (sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ) = 1.
Expression = 1 + 4 = 5.

questions.question_en: If cot⁴A + cot²A = 1, then find the value of cos⁴A – 3 cos²A.
questions.question_hi: यदि cot⁴A + cot²A = 1, तो cos⁴A – 3cos²A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
cot²A(cot²A + 1) = 1 ⇒ cot²A · cosec²A = 1 ⇒ cos²A / sin⁴A = 1 ⇒ cos²A = sin⁴A = (1 - cos²A)².
cos²A = 1 - 2 cos²A + cos⁴A ⇒ cos⁴A - 3 cos²A = -1.

questions.question_en: If 3 sin θ + 5 cos θ = 5, find the value of 5 sin θ – 3 cos θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि 3sinθ + 5cosθ = 5, तो 5sinθ – 3cosθ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
If a sin θ + b cos θ = c and b sin θ - a cos θ = x, then a² + b² = c² + x².
3² + 5² = 5² + x² ⇒ 9 + 25 = 25 + x² ⇒ x² = 9 ⇒ x = ±3.

questions.question_en: If cosec θ + cot θ = p, then find the value of (p² – 1) / (p² + 1).
questions.question_hi: यदि cosecθ + cotθ = p है, तो (p² – 1) / (p² + 1) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
cosec θ + cot θ = p ⇒ cosec θ - cot θ = 1/p.
Subtracting: 2 cot θ = p - 1/p = (p² - 1)/p.
Adding: 2 cosec θ = p + 1/p = (p² + 1)/p.
Dividing: (2 cot θ) / (2 cosec θ) = (p² - 1) / (p² + 1) ⇒ (cos θ / sin θ) / (1 / sin θ) = cos θ.

questions.question_en: If sin A + cos A = √2, determine the value of tan A + cot A.
questions.question_hi: यदि sin A + cos A = √2 है, तो tan A + cot A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Squaring both sides: (sin A + cos A)² = 2 ⇒ 1 + 2 sin A cos A = 2 ⇒ 2 sin A cos A = 1 ⇒ sin A cos A = 1/2.
tan A + cot A = (sin²A + cos²A) / (sin A cos A) = 1 / (1/2) = 2.

questions.question_en: Simplify the expression: (cos³θ + sin³θ)/(cos θ + sin θ) + (cos³θ – sin³θ)/(cos θ – sin θ).
questions.question_hi: व्यंजक को सरल कीजिए: (cos³θ + sin³θ)/(cos θ + sin θ) + (cos³θ – sin³θ)/(cos θ – sin θ)
questions.solution:
(cos³θ + sin³θ)/(cos θ + sin θ) = cos²θ - cos θ sin θ + sin²θ = 1 - sin θ cos θ.
(cos³θ - sin³θ)/(cos θ - sin θ) = cos²θ + cos θ sin θ + sin²θ = 1 + sin θ cos θ.
Sum = (1 - sin θ cos θ) + (1 + sin θ cos θ) = 2.

questions.question_en: If sec²θ + tan²θ = 7/12, find the value of sec⁴θ – tan⁴θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि sec²θ + tan²θ = 7/12, तो sec⁴θ – tan⁴θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution: sec⁴θ - tan⁴θ = (sec²θ - tan²θ)(sec²θ + tan²θ) = 1 × (7/12) = 7/12.

questions.question_en: If θ is acute and 2 sin θ + 3 cos θ = √13, then find tan θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि θ न्यूनकोण है और 2sinθ + 3cosθ = √13, तो tanθ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
In a sin θ + b cos θ = √(a² + b²): here a = 2, b = 3 and √(2² + 3²) = √13.
This occurs when sin θ = a/√(a²+b²) = 2/√13 and cos θ = b/√(a²+b²) = 3/√13.
tan θ = sin θ / cos θ = 2/3.
questions.trick: tan θ = coefficient of sin θ / coefficient of cos θ = 2/3.

questions.question_en: If θ is acute and cosec θ + cot θ = 4, then find cos θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि θ न्यूनकोण है और cosecθ + cotθ = 4, तो cosθ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
cosec θ + cot θ = 4 ⇒ cosec θ - cot θ = 1/4.
2 cosec θ = 4 + 1/4 = 17/4 ⇒ cosec θ = 17/8 ⇒ sin θ = 8/17.
cos θ = √(1 - (8/17)²) = 15/17.

questions.question_en: If sin θ cos θ = 1/3, then find the value of sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि sinθcosθ = 1/3, तो sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution: sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)² - 2 sin²θ cos²θ = 1² - 2(sin θ cos θ)² = 1 - 2(1/3)² = 1 - 2/9 = 7/9.

questions.exam: SSC SELECTION PHASE HIGHER SECONDARY LEVEL 2026
questions.question_en: If sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = 7/9, then find tan²θ + cot²θ.
questions.question_hi: यदि sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = 7/9, तो tan²θ + cot²θ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = 1 - 2 sin²θ cos²θ = 7/9 ⇒ 2 sin²θ cos²θ = 2/9 ⇒ sin²θ cos²θ = 1/9 ⇒ sin θ cos θ = 1/3.
tan θ + cot θ = 1 / (sin θ cos θ) = 3.
tan²θ + cot²θ = (tan θ + cot θ)² - 2 = 3² - 2 = 7.

questions.question_en: The angle of elevation of the top of an upright tower from the top of a straight pole 24√3 feet high is 60°. If the base of the pillar was at a distance of 60 feet from the base of the tower, then what was the height (in feet) of the tower?
questions.question_hi: 24√3 फ़ीट ऊँचे एक सीधे खड़े खम्भे के शिखर से एक सीधी खड़ी मीनार के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 60° था। यदि खम्बे का आधार मीनार के आधार से 60 फ़ीट की दूरी पर था, तो मीनार की ऊँचाई क्या थी?
questions.solution:
Height above pole = d × tan 60° = 60 × √3 = 60√3 feet.
Total height of tower = 60√3 + 24√3 = 84√3 feet.

questions.question_en: From the top of a tower, the angle of depression of the top of a 10 m high building is 60°. If the distance between the tower and the building is 50√3 m, find the height of the tower.
questions.question_hi: किसी टावर के शीर्ष से, 10मी. ऊँची बिल्डिंग के शीर्ष का अवनमन कोण 60° है। यदि टावर और बिल्डिंग के बीच की दूरी 50√3 मी. है, तो उस टावर की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए:
questions.solution:
Height above building h' = d × tan 60° = 50√3 × √3 = 150 m.
Total height = h' + 10 = 150 + 10 = 160 m.

questions.question_en: From a point exactly midway between the foot of two towers P and Q, the angles of elevation their tops are 30° and 60°, respectively. The ratio of the height of P to that of Q is:
questions.question_hi: दो टावरों P और Q के पैर के बीचो बीच बिल्कुल एक बिंदु से, उनके शीर्ष की ऊँचाई के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 30° और 60° हैं। P की Q की ऊँचाई का अनुपात है:
questions.solution:
Since the point is midway, distances d are equal.
h_P = d tan 30° = d / √3.
h_Q = d tan 60° = d √3.
h_P / h_Q = (d / √3) / (d √3) = 1 / 3.
Ratio = 1 : 3.

questions.question_en: The angles of elevation of the top of a tower from two points situated at distances p and q from the base of the tower on the same straight line are 27° and 63°, respectively. What is the height of the tower?
questions.question_hi: एक टावर के आधार से एक ही सीधी रेखा पर p और q दूरी पर स्थित दो बिंदुओं से टावर के शिखर के उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 27° और 63° हैं। टावर की ऊँचाई क्या है?
questions.solution:
Since 27° + 63° = 90° (complementary angles):
h = p tan 27° and h = q tan 63° = q cot 27°.
h² = (p tan 27°)(q cot 27°) = pq ⇒ h = √(pq).
